pages.title: Stage Clear
pages.text: The Stage Clear jingle of Vectorman (BlueSky Software, 1995) lasts about five seconds.

pages.title: Counting the score
pages.text: At the end of each stage of Vectorman, bonus points are given for the time left, the TVs destroyed and the photons collected, according to Sega Retro. There is also a "Pacifist Bonus" for finishing a stage without firing a shot.
